page_title: LIL 1-1 PSG | Lille v PSG 17/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+3' 1 - 1 Jonathan David (Lille) gets to the rebound in the goalmouth and plants a header home.
90+3' Adam Ounas (Lille) unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, but it goes straight at Arnau Tenas.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' Marquinhos (PSG) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
90' That will be all from Benjamin Andre who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Adam Ounas (Lille).
90' Marquinhos (PSG) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
90' Angel Gomes (Lille) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it fails to bother the goalkeeper as it hits the defensive wall.
89' Vitinha (PSG) was too forceful with his tackle and Willy Delajod interrupted the game to signal a free kick. Lille are awarded a free kick.
88' The ball goes out of play. Lille are awarded a corner kick.
88' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Lille.
88' Tiago Santos (Lille) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender. It will be a corner kick for Lille.
87' A pass from Angel Gomes (Lille) is intercepted by Arnau Tenas and the move breaks down.
86' Randal Kolo Muani (PSG) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Willy Delajod saw the whole situation.

85' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) is all over the pitch today. He is full of energy and asking for the ball, while his ability to control the game and to be on the ball is simply fantastic. Every manager wants to have a playmaker like him.
83' Benjamin Andre (Lille) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
82' Willy Delajod blows his whistle after Randal Kolo Muani (PSG) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
81' The resulting corner from Kang-In Lee (PSG) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
81' Paulo Fonseca prepares a substitution. Yusuf Yazici is replaced by Jonathan David (Lille).
81' It's time for a substitution. Marco Asensio (PSG) comes on in place of Ousmane Dembele.
80' Lille can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

80' Yusuf Yazici (Lille) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Lille.
77' Kylian Mbappe (PSG) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Willy Delajod blows his whistle for a foul.
75' Here comes a substitution. Milan Skriniar (PSG) is brought on as a substitute for Danilo Pereira.
75' 7:10 – the total goal attempt statistics. The current number of shots on goal is 0:2.
72' Lille are ruled offside.
71' Substitution. Bafode Diakite makes way for Tiago Santos (Lille).
71' Here is a change. Gabriel Gudmundsson is going off and Paulo Fonseca gives the last tactical orders to Remy Cabella (Lille).
67' Luis Enrique has decided to substitute Manuel Ugarte and he is replaced by Achraf Hakimi (PSG).
67' Here's the change. Bradley Barcola leaves the pitch and Randal Kolo Muani (PSG) comes on as a substitute.
66' 0 - 1 Goal! Kylian Mbappe (PSG) puts the ball into the left side of the goal past the outstretched arm of Lucas Chevalier.
66' Kylian Mbappe (PSG) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
66' Bafode Diakite (Lille) has tested the patience of referee Willy Delajod and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
65' Bafode Diakite (Lille) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
65' Looks like Lucas Hernandez (PSG) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.

64' Bafode Diakite (Lille) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle. The referee uncompromisingly points to the spot and it's a penalty to PSG.
63' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
63' A cross from Bradley Barcola (PSG) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
62' Great teamplay by PSG as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
60' The resulting set piece from PSG is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
59' Kylian Mbappe (PSG) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
56' Angel Gomes (Lille) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
56' Angel Gomes (Lille) takes the corner.
55' Vitinha (PSG) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Willy Delajod blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
54' Bradley Barcola (PSG) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
50' Angel Gomes (Lille) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
49' Angel Gomes (Lille) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety. Now Lille have a corner.
48' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from PSG.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+1' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Corner kick. Kang-In Lee (PSG) is ready to send the ball into the box.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
45' Kang-In Lee (PSG) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.

45' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. Corner kick. PSG will have an opportunity.
44' Kang-In Lee (PSG) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
44' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. PSG have been awarded a corner kick.
42' Ismaily (Lille) is able to continue to play.
41' Ismaily (Lille) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
41' Willy Delajod blows for a foul after Lucas Hernandez (PSG) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
39' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) commits a foul after unfairly pressing his opponent during an attacking move.
36' The ball is out of play and PSG manage to earn a corner.
36' PSG quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

36' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Vitinha (PSG) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the top right corner, but Lucas Chevalier pulls off a brilliant save. Good work from PSG as they win a corner.
35' PSG are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
33' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
32' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Willy Delajod has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
30' Kylian Mbappe (PSG) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
29' Angel Gomes (Lille) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
29' Lucas Hernandez (PSG) commits a rough challenge and Willy Delajod blows his whistle for an infringement. Lille are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
27' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
26' Lucas Hernandez (PSG) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
25' PSG seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
23' The ball is cleared after Manuel Ugarte (PSG) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
21' Close! Ousmane Dembele (PSG) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lille.
18' Willy Delajod shows a yellow card to Manuel Ugarte (PSG) for his blatant foul.
17' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Willy Delajod blows for a foul.

16' A brilliant individual effort! Edon Zhegrova (Lille) tricks his way past challenges into the box and drags his shot narrowly wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for PSG.

15' Good chance! Edon Zhegrova (Lille) nicely turned his man inside the box but placed his effort just wide of the right post. He should have scored! The ball goes out of play and PSG will have a goal kick.
14' Kylian Mbappe (PSG) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
13' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
13' Benjamin Andre (Lille) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
12' Dangerous play by Bradley Barcola (PSG). Willy Delajod blows his whistle for a foul.
11' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
10' PSG enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
7' Kylian Mbappe (PSG) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
7' Kylian Mbappe (PSG) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
6' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
6' Kang-In Lee (PSG) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
4' The PSG players are exchanging some short passes.
2' Kylian Mbappe (PSG) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Willy Delajod blows for a foul.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
PSG will kick the game off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Willy Delajod.
